description: This file contains a comprehensive test suite for verifying exception propagation in Orleans, a distributed virtual actor framework. The tests cover exception types, stack traces, aggregate exceptions, serialization/deserialization failures, and grain-to-grain communication exception handling.

classes.name: ExceptionPropagationTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies various aspects of exception propagation across distributed Orleans grains, including exception types, stack trace preservation, nesting, and serialization errors.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: A fixture class setting up the Orleans test cluster environment for the tests.

classes.name: MessageSerializationClientObject
classes.description: A helper class implementing message serialization client-side interface, used to test serialization failures during client-grain communication.

methods.name: ExceptionsPropagatedFromGrainToClient
methods.description: Verifies that exceptions thrown by grains are propagated to clients with their original type and message.

methods.name: BasicExceptionPropagation
methods.description: Ensures that exception types thrown within grain methods are correctly propagated back to the caller.

methods.name: ExceptionContainsOriginalStackTrace
methods.description: Checks that remote stack traces are preserved in propagated exceptions, including origin information.

methods.name: ExceptionContainsOriginalStackTraceWhenRethrowingLocally
methods.description: Verifies that rethrowing exceptions with async/await retains original remote stack traces.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagationDoesNotUnwrapAggregateExceptions
methods.description: Confirms that AggregateException structures are preserved during propagation and not flattened.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagationDoesNoFlattenAggregateExceptions
methods.description: Checks that nested AggregateExceptions maintain their hierarchy during propagation.

methods.name: TaskCancelationPropagation
methods.description: Tests that task cancellation requests are propagated as TaskCanceledException.

methods.name: GrainForwardingExceptionPropagation
methods.description: Validates exception propagation when one grain calls another that throws an exception.

methods.name: GrainForwardingExceptionPropagationDoesNotUnwrapAggregateExceptions
methods.description: Ensures exceptions propagated through grain calls retain AggregateException structure.

methods.name: SynchronousExceptionThrownShouldResultInFaultedTask
methods.description: Verifies that synchronous exceptions thrown within grain methods produce faulted tasks rather than immediate exceptions.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagationForwardsEntireAggregateException
methods.description: Checks that all inner exceptions in an aggregate fault are propagated, not just the first one.

methods.name: SynchronousAggregateExceptionThrownShouldResultInFaultedTaskWithOriginalAggregateExceptionUnmodifiedAsInnerException
methods.description: Ensures synchronous AggregateExceptions thrown in grain methods appear as faulted tasks with unmodified inner exceptions.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_GrainCallsClient_Request_Deserialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation in case the grain fails to deserialize a client request.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_GrainCallsClient_Response_Serialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when the client response serialization fails.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_GrainCallsClient_Response_Deserialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when the client fails to deserialize a response from a grain.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_GrainCallsClient_Request_Serialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when the client request serialization fails.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_GrainCallsGrain_Request_Deserialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when deserialization of a grain-to-grain call request fails.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_GrainCallsGrain_Request_Serialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when serialization of a grain-to-grain request fails.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_GrainCallsGrain_Response_Serialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when serialization of a grain-to-grain response fails.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_GrainCallsGrain_Response_Deserialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when deserialization of a grain-to-grain response fails.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_ClientCallsGrain_Request_Deserialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when a grain cannot deserialize a request from a client.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_ClientCallsGrain_Request_Serialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when the client request serialization to a grain fails.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_ClientCallsGrain_Response_Serialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when the grain response serialization to a client fails.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_ClientCallsGrain_Response_Deserialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception propagation when the client fails to deserialize a response from a grain.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_ClientCallsGrain_Request_Deserialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception handling when a request from client to grain cannot be deserialized.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_ClientCallsGrain_Request_Serialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception handling when a request from client to grain cannot be serialized.

methods.name: ExceptionPropagation_ClientCallsGrain_Response_Serialization_Failure
methods.description: Tests exception handling when a response from grain to client cannot be serialized.
